capability: Seven kinds of check on every film
title: Seven gates watch every frame.

hook.picture: Close on the whale taking off from the line. One frame snaps round too fast, and a phone pod flinches ✕.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: It looked smooth to me. Then it jerked on my phone.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: a maker watching their own video on a phone

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: A long strip of frames runs past the maker's eye. Three times, faster each time, a different flaw slips by and the phone pod flinches.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: One person cannot watch every frame.

stakes.body: Small flaws you can't see on your own screen reach every viewer, and they read as carelessness.

solution_hint: Give each kind of flaw its own check.

metaphor.body: Seven gates, each with its own icon, watch a film's frames for seven different kinds of flaw, including the film's own whale turning too fast.

steps.picture: Three gates rise, each with an icon: a clock (time to read), a turn arrow (how fast the whale turns), a flash.
A caption that leaves too fast stops at the clock gate. The bar drops.
steps.words: Each gate watches for one kind of flaw.

steps.picture: Push-in: the whale's own snap take-off stops at the turn gate.
The whale smooths its turn and passes. Tick.
steps.words: It caught our own whale turning too fast.

steps.picture: Four more gates rise: loudness, size, colours and a watching eye. Seven icons, seven kinds.
The film's strip threads all seven gates.

real_case.claim: Whale Line, The brief v1: seven gates (read time, frame jump, flash, loudness, ffprobe, contact sheet, colour provenance) found three fixes before render, including the whale's take-off snap.

honest_limit.picture: A dull, lifeless strip passes all seven gates, every opening glowing. The phone pod watches unmoved and scrolls away.
honest_limit.words: A dull film passes every gate too.

ending_pattern.body: The same close take-off as bar 1 plays again, and the whale turns smoothly inside the turn gate's opening. The phone pod answers ✓.
ending_pattern.callback: Same close framing on the same take-off: the snap that made the pod flinch is gone.

end_belief.body: Let machines count. You judge what matters.
